compiler_spec.usage: The locked BfdArchitecture is initialized over examples/curl only to supply the production TypeFactory and alignment/architecture state; the fixture then calls TypeFactory::clear and owns every compared registration. The Rust comparand installs the same <size_alignment_map> (1/1,2/2,4/4,8/8,16/16) before its first clear so findAdd's alignment precondition matches the production factory.

analysis_options.factory_state: After BfdArchitecture::init, clear the TypeFactory. Initial wave registers two plain signed bytes, two plain unsigned bytes, and one caller-named ASCII signed byte, then caches twice. A later higher-id plain signed byte is registered and cached. The factory is cleared twice, an empty-cache unnamed signed byte is observed, cleared again, then a post-clear plain byte and later ASCII byte are registered across repeated cache calls. REWORK waves: wide chars (2/4) plus plain int2 and float10/float16 slots; a stack-allocated raw TypeFactory probing the uninitialized alignment map, getTypeVoid, and the char cache miss; a named non-core promo_plain registered via the named getBase then promoted by setCoreType with clearNoncore retention and both conflict error paths; three decodeCoreTypes streams (full six-child rebuild, enum-only nochar winner, shared-id partial state, id-less void) and a large-base u1 wave converting getBase(20,INT)/getBase(12,FLOAT) into unnamed arrays.
analysis_options.ordering: DatatypeSet order is sub-metatype ascending, size descending, unsigned id ascending (compareDependency + DatatypeCompare id tie-break). Ordinary preferred slots are first-fill, ASCII character slots overwrite, type_nochar is overwritten by every ordered non-ASCII TYPE_INT size-1 core entry (a size-1 signed enum qualifies before its isEnumType break), and decode children are processed in stream order with cacheCoreTypes skipped when a child throws.
analysis_options.normalization: None. Exact names, unsigned ids, size, numeric locked metatype, core/ASCII flags, verbatim single-line LowlevelError texts (and the first line of the multi-line Shared type id message), and boolean same-factory pointer identity are emitted in fixed order and compared byte-for-byte.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; ordered tree traversal and name hashing are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: same-name size conflict, same-name char/plain submeta conflict, shared-id structural conflict, id-less named void, size-5 and cache-miss character requests, raw-constructor findAdd; Rust lock poisoning remains outside this fixture

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))

observation_schema.format: 220 newline-terminated key=value records in fixed order
observation_schema.type_record: exact name, unsigned id, byte size, locked numeric metatype, core flag, and ASCII flag
observation_schema.identity: Pointer equality in Ghidra and Arc::ptr_eq in Rugra for preferred, nochar, charcache, repeated access, repeated cache, late registration, empty-cache fallback, post-clear reconstruction, wide/float slot selection, promotion factory views, conflict survivors, decode rebuild winners, and repeated large-base arrays
observation_schema.error_records: verbatim LowlevelError texts for alter-definition (size and submeta variants), unsupported character data-type, alignment map not initialized, Datatype must have a valid id, and the first line of Shared type id; throw/no-throw flags precede each text
observation_schema.lifetime: No pre-clear Ghidra pointer is dereferenced or compared after clear deletes it

comparand.build_mode: Archive the pinned Rugra base commit/tree, overlay only the hash-verified live src/type_system/typefactory.rs, build --locked --offline in a temporary target directory, and compile the hash-verified standalone Rust fixture against that isolated library. Other live dirty Rust files are never consumed. Re-pinned from 296c128 to 71971b2 by TYPEFACTORY-LEGACY-CALLER-MIGRATION-0001 because the datatype.rs Result-returning decode_basic/decode_code_stub/decode_prototype the current typefactory.rs consumes entered datatype.rs after 296c128, leaving the old pin uncompilable at HEAD.

coverage.wide_character_charcache_and_non_preferr: MATCH: setCoreType chartp size!=1 routes through getTypeUnicode (utf16/utf32 flags, SUB_*_UNICODE ordering); charcache[2] selects the utf2 entry while the preferred (2,INT) slot goes to the plain int2
coverage.float10_float16_dedicated_slots: MATCH: typecache10/typecache16 serve getBase(10/16,TYPE_FLOAT) after cacheCoreTypes
coverage.char_size5_and_cache_miss_exception: MATCH: getTypeChar(5) and the raw-factory getTypeChar(1) raise the verbatim Request for unsupported character data-type LowlevelError
coverage.raw_constructor_state: MATCH: the stack-allocated raw TypeFactory reproduces the uninitialized alignment map LowlevelError on getBase and the self-caching getTypeVoid singleton
coverage.existing_noncore_to_core_promotion_facto: MATCH: the promoted registration keeps name/id/size and flips core, wins preferred/nochar after cacheCoreTypes, and survives clearNoncore
coverage.same_name_conflicting_core_registration: MATCH: both conflict variants (size and char/plain submeta) return the verbatim alter-definition LowlevelError with unchanged survivor state and unaffected preferred cache
coverage.decode_core_types_stream_rebuild: MATCH: full clear + force-core children + cacheCoreTypes; the decoded void enters nametree/tree with its explicit id and serves getTypeVoid
coverage.core_enum_cache_participation: MATCH: decoded enum_int children enter the ordered tree through findAdd; with no plain size-1 INT competitor the enum wins type_nochar while the preferred slot falls through to an unnamed entry
coverage.decode_error_partial_state: MATCH: the shared-id stream decodes its first child, throws the Shared type id LowlevelError (first line verbatim), leaves the conflicting name absent and the cache pass unrun; the id-less named void raises Datatype must have a valid id
coverage.max_basetype_size_array_conversion: MATCH: getBase(20,TYPE_INT)/getBase(12,TYPE_FLOAT) convert to unnamed arrays of the cached 1-byte unknown with element identity and repeat canonicalization
coverage.external_old_handle_lifetime_after_clear: UNTESTED: Ghidra deletes the objects while an external Rust Arc can retain them; no invalid Ghidra pointer is compared; TYPEFACTORY-CORE-PROMOTION-IDENTITY-0001
coverage.external_stale_handle_promotion_flag_vis: MISMATCH: Ghidra ORs the core flag in place so a stale external pointer observes it; Rugra's immutable Arc replaces every factory channel instead, so only factory-mediated observations match. Requires the datatype.rs interior-mutability rework (separate lease); TYPEFACTORY-CORE-PROMOTION-IDENTITY-0001
coverage.legacy_arc_wrapper_callers: MISMATCH: set_core_type/get_base/get_type_void keep Arc/Option compat signatures for leased callers (cpool.rs/merge.rs tests, grammar.rs); the faithful Result twins are exercised here; TYPEFACTORY-LEGACY-CALLER-MIGRATION-0001
coverage.production_alignment_map_wiring: UNTESTED: findAdd's alignment gate is enforced only on get_base_result because Rugra's architecture wiring does not feed the decoded map to the factory yet; the fixture installs the production map explicitly; TYPEFACTORY-ARCH-ALIGNMAP-WIRING-0001
coverage.rust_lock_poisoning: UNTESTED: RwLock is Rust ownership glue with no Ghidra input equivalent; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.general_pointer_array_aggregate_tree: MISMATCH: existing TYPE-0001 structural-registry gap (container component ordering and the multi-id name cross-reference)

status_note: All 220 targeted TypeFactory observations — the original 99 cache/nochar/clear records plus the REWORK waves for wide/float slots, raw-constructor state, promotion, conflict partial state, decodeCoreTypes (enum tree participation, shared-id and missing-id errors), and the large-base array conversion — are byte-identical against locked Ghidra 12.0.4. The module remains overall MISMATCH/L2: external stale-handle promotion flag visibility (immutable Arc model), the legacy Arc compat wrappers, production alignment-map wiring, the general container tree/multi-id name map (TYPE-0001), and the code-flags decode family stay registered.
